ov: The largest living lizard, a monitor lizard found only on a few Indonesian islands. It’s an apex predator that ambushes deer and pigs, eats a lot of carrion, and has a venomous bite.

why.dg: Attacks are rare, but Komodo dragons have killed people, both in the wild and in captivity.

rg: The Indonesian islands of Komodo, Rinca, Flores, Gili Dasami and Gili Motang.
df: Adults eat mainly Javan rusa deer and feral pigs, plus carrion; the young take insects and birds.
fx: Young Komodo dragons live in trees to avoid cannibal adults.
_t: Is a Komodo Dragon Dangerous? Diet, Size & Quick Facts
